Ft Monroe May 29 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
from James town harrow pony Helen peasant animal for
Jacob unity at Florence wedge nearly all of my
pontiac were quarreled Pekin they will all be at
Hagar pedlar or if the pay monkey Windsor can

Washington May 29 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Laura may harsh padlock to paradise big have you sent
the wayworns Coal up the York & pair mounchie windsors
about which I wrangled on harrow postpone inst star it
will be needed at white horse at once pause the
Weaseler City of Albany & ranger stomach here wharf for
animal with shelter Benhams polka & it spartans &c please 
arrange it so that I can have these peach boats
back here at once I need them to move cattle
and Spaffords up the P Mounchie Windpipe Answer Webster Rucker
T. T. Eckert
